name: Hermes Agent
short_desc: Autonomous AI agent - Telegram/Discord gateway, local models, self-improving skills
author: Nous Research
description: Hermes is an autonomous AI agent with persistent memory, multi-platform gateway (Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, etc.), and self-improving skills system. Supports both cloud APIs (OpenRouter) and local LLMs (LM Studio, llama.cpp) for privacy-first operation.

form_fields.label: OpenRouter API Key
form_fields.help_text: Get your key at https://openrouter.ai/keys (for cloud LLM access)

form_fields.label: Telegram Bot Token
form_fields.help_text: Get from @BotFather on Telegram (for messaging gateway)

form_fields.label: Local Model URL
form_fields.help_text: URL for local LLM server (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:1234/v1 for LM Studio)

form_fields.label: Enable API Server
form_fields.help_text: Enable web API server for OpenWebUI integration

form_fields.label: API Server Port
form_fields.help_text: Port for the API server (requires Enable API Server)
